name: 2018 Pre-K School Directory
description:
This dataset is a 2018 directory of pre-kindergarten schools and programs in New York City, with 1,789 rows and 85 columns. Each row represents a school or program and includes its name, address, borough, school district, program type (such as District School, NYCEEC, Pre-K Center, or Charter School), phone number, contact name and email, and website. It also records program details such as full- or half-day schedules, dual-language offerings, number of seats, daily hours, meals, playspace, uniforms, accessibility, early drop-off and late pick-up options, and bus and subway access. Admissions-related fields describe priorities and eligibility, including sibling, zone, and district preferences, plus notes on magnet and diversity programs. Geographic fields include ZIP code, latitude and longitude, community board, council district, census tract, and BBL/BIN property identifiers.
